overview.en: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct is a Mixture-of-Experts coding model with 30.5B total parameters and 3.3B activated per token. It targets agentic coding, repository-level code generation, and tool calling, and supports a native context length of 262144 tokens. This recipe covers the three single-node scenarios used by the upstream tutorial: high throughput (TP1), low latency (TP4 with expert parallelism), and long context (TP4 with 131072 tokens).
overview.zh: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct 是 30.5B 总参、3.3B 激活的 MoE 代码模型，面向智能体编码、仓库级代码生成与工具调用，原生支持 262144 tokens 上下文。本 recipe 覆盖上游教程的三个单节点场景：高吞吐（TP1）、低时延（TP4 + 专家并行）与 131072 tokens 长上下文（TP4）。

quantization.content.en:
The W8A8 checkpoint uses a hybrid strategy:

- **Embedding layer**: BF16 (not quantized)
- **Q/K normalization** (`q_norm`, `k_norm`): BF16 weights and biases
- **Attention projections** (`q/k/v/o_proj`): static W8A8 with per-tensor scales; biases remain BF16
- **MoE routing gate** (`mlp.gate`): BF16
- **MoE expert projections** (`gate/up/down_proj`): dynamic W8A8, with input scales computed during inference

If the pre-quantized checkpoint is unavailable, quantize the BF16 model with **msmodelslim** following the [Quantization Guide](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/user_guide/feature_guide/quantization.html).
quantization.content.zh:
W8A8 权重采用混合量化策略：

- **Embedding 层**：BF16，不量化
- **Q/K 归一化**（`q_norm`、`k_norm`）：BF16
- **Attention 投影**（`q/k/v/o_proj`）：静态 W8A8，per-tensor scale，bias 保持 BF16
- **MoE 路由 gate**（`mlp.gate`）：BF16
- **MoE 专家投影**（`gate/up/down_proj`）：动态 W8A8，推理时计算输入 scale

若无法获取预量化权重，可使用 **msmodelslim** 按[量化指南](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/user_guide/feature_guide/quantization.html)对 BF16 模型量化。

env_setup.container.A3.content.en:
Use the official vLLM-Ascend all-in-one image validated for this recipe.

**Docker Pull:**

```bash
docker pull quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:v0.30.0-a3-openeuler
```

**Docker Run:**

```bash
export IMAGE=quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:v0.30.0-a3-openeuler

docker run \
    --name vllm-ascend-env \
    --shm-size=128g \
    --net=host \
    --privileged=true \
    --device /dev/davinci0 \
    --device /dev/davinci1 \
    --device /dev/davinci2 \
    --device /dev/davinci3 \
    --device /dev/davinci_manager \
    --device /dev/devmm_svm \
    --device /dev/hisi_hdc \
    -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
    -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
    -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
    -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
    -v /models:/models \
    -it -d $IMAGE bash
```

> **Note**: Atlas 800I A3 has 8 NPUs with a dual-die design (16 chips). This recipe uses at most 4 chips (`/dev/davinci0` to `/dev/davinci3`). Add more device mounts if you want to expose the remaining chips.

scenarios[0].steps[0].content.en:
Single-chip deployment (TP1) maximizes aggregate throughput for many concurrent requests. The server below uses chip 0 and a 37364-token context window.

```bash
export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
export HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE="AIV"
export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024
export OMP_PROC_BIND=false
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True

vllm serve your_model_path \
    --served-model-name qwen3-coder \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --max-num-seqs {{max_num_seqs}} \
    --max-model-len {{max_model_len}} \
    --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 \
    --tensor-parallel-size 1 \
    --distributed_executor_backend "mp" \
    {{prefix_caching}} \
    {{async_scheduling}} \
    --quantization ascend \
    {{compilation_config}} \
    --additional-config '{"weight_nz_mode": 2}' \
    --gpu-memory-utilization {{gpu_memory_utilization}} \
    --port 8000 \
    {{spec_decoding}}
```

> - `--quantization ascend` is required for the W8A8 checkpoint.
> - `--no-enable-prefix-caching` is the validated default; enable prefix caching only after measuring the hit rate of your workload.
> - `--max-num-seqs` and `--max-model-len` can be reduced when NPU memory is shared with other services.

scenarios[1].steps[0].content.en:
Four-chip tensor parallelism with expert parallelism reduces per-token latency. FlashComm1 is enabled for this scenario.

```bash
export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3
export HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE="AIV"
export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024
export OMP_PROC_BIND=false
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True

vllm serve your_model_path \
    --served-model-name qwen3-coder \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --max-num-seqs {{max_num_seqs}} \
    --max-model-len {{max_model_len}} \
    --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 \
    --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
    --enable-expert-parallel \
    --distributed_executor_backend "mp" \
    {{prefix_caching}} \
    {{async_scheduling}} \
    --quantization ascend \
    {{compilation_config}} \
    --additional-config '{"enable_flashcomm1": true, "weight_nz_mode": 2}' \
    --gpu-memory-utilization {{gpu_memory_utilization}} \
    --port 8000 \
    {{spec_decoding}}
```

> - Assign four chips to `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES`; TP4 maps one rank to each chip.
> - `--enable-expert-parallel` distributes the 128 MoE experts across the four ranks.

scenarios[2].steps[0].content.en:
The long-context scenario keeps TP4 with expert parallelism, raises the context limit to 131072 tokens, and lowers `--max-num-seqs` to 14 to leave room for the KV cache. Qwen3-Coder natively supports 262144 tokens, so no RoPE scaling is required for 131072.

```bash
export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3
export HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE="AIV"
export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024
export OMP_PROC_BIND=false
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True

vllm serve your_model_path \
    --served-model-name qwen3-coder \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --max-num-seqs 14 \
    --max-model-len 131072 \
    --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 \
    --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
    --enable-expert-parallel \
    --distributed_executor_backend "mp" \
    {{prefix_caching}} \
    {{async_scheduling}} \
    --quantization ascend \
    {{compilation_config}} \
    --additional-config '{"enable_flashcomm1": true, "weight_nz_mode": 2}' \
    --gpu-memory-utilization {{gpu_memory_utilization}} \
    --port 8000 \
    {{spec_decoding}}
```

> - For contexts above 262144 tokens, add `--hf-overrides '{"rope_parameters": {"rope_type": "yarn", "factor": 4, "original_max_position_embeddings": 262144}}'`.
> - Reduce `--max-num-seqs` further if the measured KV-cache usage approaches the NPU memory limit.

```bash

export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024

vllm serve your_model_path \

    --trust-remote-code \
    --max-num-seqs 14 \
    --max-model-len 131072 \
    --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 \
    --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
    --enable-expert-parallel \
    --distributed_executor_backend "mp" \
    {{prefix_caching}} \
    {{async_scheduling}} \
    --quantization ascend \
    {{compilation_config}} \
    --additional-config '{"enable_flashcomm1": true, "weight_nz_mode": 2}' \
    --gpu-memory-utilization {{gpu_memory_utilization}} \
    --port 8000 \
    {{spec_decoding}}
```

> - 超过 262144 tokens 时需追加 `--hf-overrides '{"rope_parameters": {"rope_type": "yarn", "factor": 4, "original_max_position_embeddings": 262144}}'`。
> - 若 KV Cache 接近 NPU 显存上限，可继续降低 `--max-num-seqs`。

scenarios[2].steps[1].content.en:
Send a prompt that exceeds 32768 tokens and check that the answer stays coherent.

```bash
curl http://localhost:<port>/v1/chat/completions \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{
        "model": "qwen3-coder",
        "messages": [
            {"role": "user", "content": "Summarize the key risks of a large-scale software migration in three bullet points."}
        ],
        "temperature": 0,
        "max_tokens": 256
    }'
```

Expected result: HTTP 200 with a non-empty `choices` array and no timeout.

After the service is started, send a chat request. Replace `<port>` with the port from the `vllm serve` command.

```bash
curl http://localhost:<port>/v1/chat/completions \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{
        "model": "qwen3-coder",
        "messages": [
            {"role": "user", "content": "Give me a short introduction to large language models."}
        ],
        "temperature": 0.6,
        "top_p": 0.95,
        "max_tokens": 512
    }'
```

performance.benchmark.en:
### Measured Results

All numbers below were collected on one Atlas 800I A3 node (16 chips available; at most 4 used) with `quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:v0.30.0-a3-openeuler`.

| Scenario | TP | Requests | Concurrency | Output tok/s | Mean TTFT (ms) | Mean TPOT (ms) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| High Throughput | 1 | 100/100 | 32 | 756.42 | 1205.82 | 36.56 |
| Low Latency | 4 | 100/100 | 32 | 1219.29 | 1007.98 | 21.35 |
| Long Context | 4 | 20/20 | 4 | 221.63 | 735.66 | 16.64 |

Benchmark shapes: 2048 input / 2048 output tokens for high throughput and low latency; 8192 input / 512 output tokens for long context.

#### Scenario Overview

| Scenario | Deployment Mode | Total NPUs | Weight Version | Key Considerations |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| High Throughput | Single-Node (TP1) | 1 (A3) | W8A8 | Single-chip deployment maximizes concurrent request processing |
| Low Latency | Single-Node (TP4) | 2 (A3) | W8A8 | Multi-chip TP with expert parallelism reduces per-token latency |
| Long Context | Single-Node (TP4) | 2 (A3) | W8A8 | Fewer concurrent sequences leave room for a 131072-token context |

> On Atlas 800I A3 each NPU contains two dies (chips), so TP4 uses 4 chips = 2 NPUs.
performance.benchmark.zh:
### 实测结果

以下数据均在单台 Atlas 800I A3（共 16 芯片，最多使用 4 芯片）与 `quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:v0.30.0-a3-openeuler` 镜像上采集。

| 场景 | TP | 请求数 | 并发 | 输出吞吐（tok/s） | 平均 TTFT（ms） | 平均 TPOT（ms） |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 高吞吐 | 1 | 100/100 | 32 | 756.42 | 1205.82 | 36.56 |
| 低时延 | 4 | 100/100 | 32 | 1219.29 | 1007.98 | 21.35 |
| 长上下文 | 4 | 20/20 | 4 | 221.63 | 735.66 | 16.64 |

基准输入输出：高吞吐与低时延为 2048/2048 tokens；长上下文为 8192/512 tokens。

#### 场景概览

| 场景 | 部署方式 | NPU 总数 | 权重版本 | 关键考量 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 高吞吐 | 单节点（TP1） | 1（A3） | W8A8 | 单芯片部署最大化并发请求处理能力 |
| 低时延 | 单节点（TP4） | 2（A3） | W8A8 | 多芯片 TP + 专家并行降低单 token 时延 |
| 长上下文 | 单节点（TP4） | 2（A3） | W8A8 | 降低并发序列数为 131072 tokens 上下文预留空间 |

> Atlas 800I A3 每个 NPU 包含两个 die（芯片），因此 TP4 使用 4 个芯片，即 2 个 NPU。

tuning.en:
### Tuning Guidelines

- Increase `--max-num-seqs` for throughput until NPU memory or the scheduler becomes the bottleneck.
- Decrease `--max-num-seqs` and `--max-model-len` when requests time out under long prompts.
- Prefix caching is disabled in the validated scenarios because random benchmark inputs produce no cache hits. Enable it for workloads with shared prefixes and measure the hit rate first.
- Refer to the [Performance Tuning Guide](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/developer_guide/performance_and_debug/optimization_and_tuning.html) for additional options.
tuning.zh:
### 调优建议

- 逐步提高 `--max-num-seqs` 直到 NPU 显存或调度成为瓶颈。
- 长请求超时时，降低 `--max-num-seqs` 与 `--max-model-len`。
- 验证场景关闭前缀缓存，因为随机基准输入不会命中缓存；共享前缀业务可开启并先评估命中率。
- 更多选项见[性能调优文档](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/developer_guide/performance_and_debug/optimization_and_tuning.html)。

faq.en:
**Why is `--quantization ascend` required?** The validated checkpoint is W8A8. Remove the flag only when serving the BF16 checkpoint.

**Is Eagle3 speculative decoding supported?** Yes. The optional draft model is exposed as an off-by-default `spec_decoding` feature and was functionally validated on Atlas 800I A3 at TP1 (3/3 HTTP 200 responses, no ERROR/Traceback in the logs). Replace `your_eagle3_model_path` with the local draft-model directory before enabling it. The performance tables above remain the non-Eagle3 baseline.

**Why does the long-context scenario stop at 131072 tokens?** The model supports 262144 tokens natively, but 131072 is the value validated in this recipe. Raise it after checking KV-cache memory, and add YaRN overrides above 262144.
faq.zh:
**为什么必须加 `--quantization ascend`？** 本 recipe 验证的是 W8A8 权重；仅在服务 BF16 权重时移除。

**是否支持 Eagle3 投机推理？** 支持。可选的草稿模型通过默认关闭的 `spec_decoding` 特性提供，已在 Atlas 800I A3 的 TP1 上完成功能验证（3/3 HTTP 200，日志无 ERROR/Traceback）。启用前请将 `your_eagle3_model_path` 替换为本地草稿模型目录。上方性能表仍为非 Eagle3 基线。

**长上下文为什么只验证到 131072 tokens？** 模型原生支持 262144 tokens，131072 是本 recipe 的验证值。提高前请检查 KV Cache 显存；超过 262144 时需追加 YaRN 配置。
